title: Live: College Football
description: The Rainbow Warriors (2-6, 1-4) visit the Miners (1-7, 0-4) for a Mountain West affair. The programs haven't met since 2004, when they were Western Athletic Conference foes. Hawaii traveled 4,255 miles to beat Northern Illinois 56-21 last week.

title: College Football
description: The No. 8 UCLA Bruins (8-0) face the Minnesota Golden Gophers (5-3) at Huntington Bank Stadium for a Big Ten game. UCLA enters undefeated in eight games after shutting out Nevada 27-0, while Minnesota is coming off a 23-16 overtime defeat to Indiana.

title: College Football
description: The No. 19 Hawkeyes seek their fifth straight victory over the Wildcats. Both sides are 6-2, 3-2 Big Ten. Iowa recorded its third shutout of the season, holding Wisconsin to nine first downs and 235 yards from scrimmage in a 30-0 decision last week.

title: College Football
